0022600148.text: The 76ers, 4-1 and first in the Atlantic, arrive with a 2-0 road record and a one-game winning streak, while the Hornets (3-2, first in the Southeast) have lost their most recent game. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Jaylen Brown and Tacko Fall, and Charlotte is missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 118-114 win in Charlotte on March 28, 2026.
